items.title: Designing AI‑Ready systems: making code easy for assistants
items.raw_excerpt: Most leverage from AI doesn’t come from writing AI code—it comes from writing code that AI can use. When your system exposes clear contracts and examples, assistants can extend it safely. Building a copilot and an MCP server at my job made this obvious: after we added a contract API and short, focused docs, “write-a-prompt” replaced “write-a-spec” for many changes. Here’s why that works and the patterns that made it repeatable.

title_i18n.en: Designing AI‑Ready systems: making code easy for assistants
title_i18n.zh: 设计AI就绪系统：简化代码以适配助手

excerpt_i18n.en: Most leverage from AI doesn’t come from writing AI code—it comes from writing code that AI can use. When your system exposes clear contracts and examples, assistants can extend it safely. Building a copilot and an MCP server at my job made this obvious: after we added a contract API and short, focused docs, “write-a-prompt” replaced “write-a-spec” for many changes. Here’s why that works and the patterns that made it repeatable.
